subject: School Bus Stop-Arm Camera Enforcement
overview: The Medford School Committee met to begin the 2025-2026 school year, receiving presentations on summer student art projects and opening-day logistics. The Committee also approved resolutions supporting state menstrual equity legislation and requesting the City Council adopt school bus stop-arm camera enforcement.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The Committee entered executive session to discuss collective bargaining negotiations and teacher grievances.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved routine business including meeting minutes, field trips, and donations, while severing and tabling a $35,000 Cummings Foundation grant for further review.

items.title: Superintendent's Reports and Mustang Moments
items.summary: Students and fine arts staff presented on summer mural and music programs, followed by a district-wide administrative update on school opening logistics, security enhancements, and new hires.

items.title: Policy on LGBTQ+ Rights Second Reading
items.summary: Approved a policy reaffirming support for the rights of LGBTQ+ students and staff, waiving the second reading.

items.title: School Building Committee Appointments
items.summary: Approved appointing Chief Operating Officer Kenneth Lord as a voting member and Assistant Superintendent Dr. Kimberly Talbot as a non-voting member to the High School Building Committee.

items.title: Resolution in Support of the I.A.M. Bill
items.summary: Approved a resolution supporting state bills H.534 and S.2491, advocating for menstrual products to be treated as essential public goods.

items.title: Policy Hygiene (BGI)
items.summary: Approved Policy BGI with minor amendments to standardize language shortcuts and improve policy readability.

items.title: School Bus Stop-Arm Camera Enforcement Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the City Council formally adopt Chapter 399 of the Acts of 2024 to enable the installation and operation of automated school bus stop-arm enforcement cameras.

items.title: Condolences and Adjournment
items.summary: Expressed condolences to the family of long-time fourth-grade teacher Anna C. Fioretti before adjourning.
